scope: Research recheck plus real-RGB neutral shadow policy and finite native pointer compatibility. No learned inference, gameplay, GPU, LAN proof or production acceptance.

retainedNegatives.reason: unexpected_control_receipt for exact pending ACK after close started; exact drain added without reopening or replay

limitations: Neutral fixture has no learned weights; its timings are not GPU inference performance.
Shadow has no Android input sink. Chunk preview is not native hold or multi-touch execution.
Policy receives original RGB; model-specific preprocessing and a network GPU API remain open.
Receiver age is not source capture freshness or cross-host clock mapping.
5Hz sampling still decodes full shared stream; 50-device capacity unmeasured.
Necto/Nexto use structured game state, MineStudio/VPT use specialized Minecraft environments, official NitroGen play uses pauses. These are not transferable Android-game acceptance.
Coroutine cancellation does not prove GPU kernel cancellation; production provider needs process/service isolation.
Single PH011 finite tests, no general reliability SLA or GPU-host LAN proof.
